findings.summary: Mixing Table truncates multi-ingredient dish names with (+N) when mixing 4 or more ingredients, causing assistive technologies to lose critical ingredient information.
findings.evidence: const previewNames = names.slice(0, 3).join(" & "); const extraSuffix = names.length > 3 ? ` (+${names.length - 3})` : ""; const defaultMixedName = `${previewNames}${extraSuffix} (${methodLabel})`;
findings.fix: Generate defaultMixedName with the full list of ingredients (names.join(" & ")) without (+N) truncation, matching Station 10 beverage_station to ensure complete sensory information reaches NVDA users.

findings.summary: Delete button in station items list displays visible text "Xóa" but sets aria-label="Bỏ ${it.name}", omitting the visible label string and breaking speech input activation.
findings.fix: Change aria-label to begin with or contain the visible label text "Xóa", for example aria-label="Xóa ${it.name} khỏi bếp".

findings.summary: Staging transfer button with visible text "Ra khay" specifies aria-label="Cất ${it.name} ra Khay Tạm", failing to include the exact visible label phrase.
findings.evidence:
<button type="button" data-to-staging="${idx}" ... aria-label="Cất ${it.name} ra Khay Tạm">
  Ra khay
</button>
findings.fix: Update aria-label to include the visible text phrase, for example aria-label="Ra khay: Cất ${it.name} ra Khay Tạm".

findings.summary: Workbench transfer button with visible text "Vào bếp" sets aria-label="Đưa ${it.name} vào Bếp hiện tại", failing to include the exact visible text phrase.
findings.evidence:
<button type="button" data-to-st="${idx}" ... aria-label="Đưa ${it.name} vào Bếp hiện tại">
  Vào bếp
</button>
findings.fix: Update aria-label to include the exact visible label text, for example aria-label="Vào bếp: Đưa ${it.name} vào Bếp hiện tại".

findings.summary: Station selector buttons visibly show short names like "18. Bàn Trộn" but use aria-label="${st.name}. ${st.desc}", omitting the visible index and name string.
findings.fix: Set aria-label to include the visible text (e.g. `${st.shortName}: ${st.name}`) and move the station description to aria-describedby instead of replacing the accessible name.

findings.summary: When cooking is busy, action buttons visibly display "⏳ Đang chế biến..." while aria-label is set to "Đang xử lý: ${act.label}", omitting the visible text.
findings.evidence: btn.setAttribute("aria-label", `Đang xử lý: ${act.label}`); btn.textContent = "⏳ Đang chế biến...";
findings.fix: Align the accessible name with the visible label text, for example aria-label="Đang chế biến: ${act.label}".

findings.summary: Station and staging item lists use generic <div> with role="list" and role="listitem" instead of semantic HTML <ul> and <li> elements.
findings.fix: Replace container <div> elements with semantic <ul> elements and row elements with native <li> elements, removing explicit role="list" and role="listitem".

findings.summary: Empty state placeholder message is given role="listitem", causing screen readers to falsely announce that the list contains 1 item when it is empty.
findings.evidence:
listEl.innerHTML = `
Bếp đang trống. Hãy lấy nguyên liệu từ Tủ Lạnh (Alt+1) bỏ vào đây!
`;
findings.fix: Remove role="listitem" from the empty state placeholder so screen readers accurately announce an empty list (0 items).

findings.summary: Station selector grid uses role="toolbar" and aria-pressed for single-selection stations, misrepresenting mutually exclusive stations as independent toggle buttons.
findings.fix: Change container role to "radiogroup" with aria-labelledby="heading-station-picker" and child buttons to role="radio" with aria-checked.

findings.summary: Multi-ingredient dish names are visually clipped with CSS truncate without a title attribute or accessible tooltip, obscuring full recipe contents from sighted and magnification users.
findings.fix: Add title="${it.name}" to the dish name container and consider allowing multi-line wrapping so full ingredient combinations remain readable on hover and focus.

findings.summary: Station action buttons pack multi-sentence descriptions into aria-label, causing screen readers to read lengthy paragraphs as the button accessible name.
findings.fix: Keep aria-label concise (e.g. act.label) and associate the action description via aria-describedby or visible helper text.

findings.summary: Station action buttons container groups related culinary actions but lacks role="group" and an accessible name referencing the station actions heading.
Attribute aria-busy is set on a static generic <div> container without aria-live or a widget role, rendering the busy state inert to assistive technologies.
findings.fix: Remove aria-busy from #station-action-buttons or add aria-live="polite" to the container if dynamic state observation is intended.

findings.summary: Package emoji in #btn-station-to-staging is bare inline text without aria-hidden="true", causing screen readers to announce the unicode emoji name before the button label.
findings.fix: Wrap the emoji in 📦 matching other kitchen buttons.

passed: #panel-workbench has valid role="tabpanel", tabindex="0", and aria-labelledby="tab-workbench" linking to tab trigger.
Station action buttons maintain focus in-place and use aria-disabled instead of disabling elements during audio playback, preventing focus loss.
Roving tabindex keyboard navigation works across station buttons with Arrow keys, Home, and End.
Dynamic wrapper and vessel selector correctly uses role="radiogroup" with aria-labelledby pointing to visible title and role="radio" on options.
NVDA live announcements for station switching and cooking completion are dispatched with polite politeness level.
notes: Mixing Table (mixing_table) was added as Station 18; generating full multi-ingredient dish names without (+N) truncation ensures screen readers convey full recipe content, but requires accessible names on list buttons to remain concise and conform to WCAG 2.5.3 (Label in Name).
Semantic HTML refactoring of #station-items-list and #staging-items-list to native <ul> and <li> will eliminate custom ARIA roles and automatically announce correct item counts.
